lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: I can't sleep. The moon is too bright!

lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: I want to see it up close.

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: Good morning, Momo! Looking for a book?

lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: No. I'm looking for the moon.

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: Then you need a telescope. Here you go!

lines.speaker: priya
lines.text: Momo! Where are you going with that?

lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: Up the hill. Want to come?

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: Point it up. A little more.

lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: Whoa. I can see the craters!

lines.speaker: priya
lines.text: It looks like a giant cookie.
